Given the context, the relevant files are likely to be:
- **`rich/text/render.py`** (or similar files handling text rendering)
- **`rich/styling/render.py`** (or files related to styling and rendering)
- **`rich/console.py`** (or files related to console output)
- **`rich/themes.py`** (or files related to theme application)
- **`rich/renderers/code.py`** (or files handling code block rendering)

Let's start by examining the structure of the `rich` package to identify the most likely files.
